files.purpose: Pure .ics parser, escaped exporter, and event-store helpers
22 node:test cases bundling the real module through esbuild

checks.detail: installed locked dependencies in this worktree only; node_modules is gitignored

functions.parseIcs(text: string): IcsParseResult: Bounded parse. Never throws on malformed input.
functions.toIcs(events: readonly CalendarEvent[],: CRLF output, escaped text, 75-octet folding, http(s) URLs only
functions.mergeEvents(existing, incoming): {events: Keyed by id plus start; incoming wins; sorted by start; capped at MAX_EVENTS
functions.parseIcsTime(value, params): ParsedTime: DATE, UTC date-time, UTC TZID, or floating date-time
functions.unfoldLines, parseProperty, unescapeText: Lower-level helpers, exported for tests and reuse

notes: Module has no Electron, fs, or network imports. The captain wires persistence in store.ts and the IPC/contract types.
CalendarEvent is defined locally and is not in src/shared/contracts.ts. Adding it to contracts is a captain or main-API decision.

limitations: No recurrence expansion. RRULE, RDATE, EXDATE and RECURRENCE-ID events are skipped and counted, not expanded.
Only UTC (Z or UTC/GMT TZID) and floating times are accepted. Other TZIDs are skipped as unsupported-timezone because there is no timezone database here.
Floating times are read as UTC for range checks, so range results can be off by the local offset for floating events.
DURATION is ignored. An event with only DURATION gets end null.
Only http(s) URLs are kept. Nothing fetches URLs, and the module has no network access.
Import reports counts per skip reason, not per-item detail, to keep results bounded.
No personal calendar access. Tests use only in-memory .ics strings, and nothing reads a user calendar or account.
No UI, IPC, or persistence wiring. The captain must wire these helpers into the store and main process.
